brand: Servier India PVT LTD (Formerly Known As Serdia Pharmaceuticals (India) Pvt Ltd)
introduction:
Introduction About DAFLON 500MG TABLET

DAFLON 500MG TABLET is combination of Diosmin, Hesperidine, and Micronised Purified Flavonoid Fraction which belongs to the group of medicines called Venotonic and Vasculoprotector agents. It is used to manage venous circulation disorders and relieve the symptoms of acute hemorrhoidal attack.

Venous circulation disorder is a condition causing damage to the veins due to raised blood pressure inside the veins. It is characterised by symptoms such as restlessness, pain, and swelling in the legs.

Acute hemorrhoidal attack is the flare-up of veins in the rectal area, causing too much pressure and swelling inside the affected veins in the rectal area. It is characterised by symptoms such as bleeding, discomfort, anal leakage, itching, and a burning sensation.

DAFLON 500MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you are allergic to micronized, purified flavonoid fractions, especially diosmin or hesperidin. It is not recommended to be used if you have rare hereditary problems such as galactose intolerance, Lapp lactase deficiency (lactose intolerance), or glucose-galactose malabsorption.

DAFLON 500MG TABLET should be used cautiously in patients with hepatic and renal impairment. It is also not recommended to be used in pregnant women, breastfeeding mothers, children, or adolescents (under 18 years of age). Consult your doctor before taking it.

The common side effects associated with the use of DAFLON 500MG TABLET are diarrhoea, indigestion, nausea, vomiting, sleeplessness, dizziness, tiredness, and anxiety. Contact your doctor or a nearby hospital if any of the conditions worsen.
uses: Manage disorders of venous circulation disorders and relieve the symptoms of acute hemorrhoidal attack

mechanismOfAction:
How DAFLON 500MG TABLET Works

DAFLON 500MG TABLET works by work by exerting a dual action on the vein circulation system: at vein and venule (small veins) level. It increases venous tone and exerts an anti-stasis action, thereby improving the blood circulation in them. At the microcirculatory level, it optimizes the capillary (smallest blood vessels) permeability, thereby reducing blood pooling. It also reduces the release of certain inflammatory agents, thereby reducing swelling in veins.
usageDetails:
How to use DAFLON 500MG TABLET

Take DAFLON 500MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with the glass of water at mealtimes. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: VEINFLUX Capsule 10's
introduction:
Introduction About VEINFLUX CAPSULE

VEINFLUX Capsule is a dietary supplement used to support veins and to improve circulation. It can be used for the management of varicose veins, swollen legs and ankles, hemorrhoids, chronic venous insufficiency and eventually spider veins.

VEINFLUX Capsule contains Diosmin, Hesperidin, Horse Chestnut Extract, Butcher’s Broom Extract as active ingredients.

Diosmin improves vein tone, increases lymphatic drainage, inhibits inflammation, strengthens capillaries, promotes healing of varicose ulcers and has been shown in clinical studies to eliminate acute and chronic hemorrhoids.

Horse Chestnut extract reduces pain and heaviness in the legs, night-time cramps in the calves, itchy, swollen legs, hemorrhoids, and varicose veins. Butcher’s broom helps to reduce blood pooling in the lower leg and also the size of the ankle and calf. Hesperidin reduces the permeability of capillaries and is anti-inflammatory.

Always take VEINFLUX Capsule exactly as advised by your doctor. Swallow VEINFLUX Capsule with a glass of water. Do not exceed the stated recommended dosages. Before taking VEINFLUX Capsule, inform your doctor if you have any pre-existing disease conditions as a precaution.

Introduction About VEINFLUX NC TABLET

VEINFLUX NC Tablet is a dietary supplement used to support vein health and reduces varicose veins. It helps in venous insufficiency and also improves poor blood flow and micro circulation. It contains Diosmin, Nanocurcumin, Horse chestnut extract, Hesperidin, and Bioperine as active ingredients that help to reduce inflammation in blood vessels.

Diosmin, Nanocurcumin, Horse chestnut extract, Hesperidin, and Bioperine improves blood circulation by reducing inflammations that restores normal vein functioning.

Take VEINFLUX NC Tablet as advised by your doctor. Swallow VEINFLUX NC Tablet with a glass of water. Do not exceed the stated daily recommended dosage. Do not take if you are allergic to any of its ingredients.

name: Oxerute CD Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About OXERUTE CD TABLET

OXERUTE CD TABLET is a combination of Calcium dobesilate and Troxerutin which belongs to the group of medicines called Vasoprotective agents and Flavonoids respectively. It is used to manage bleeding piles and post piles surgery. It is a double power venotonic.

Hemorrhoids (piles) are swollen veins in anus and lower rectum, similar to varicose veins. It can develop inside the rectum (internal hemorrhoids) or under the skin around the anus (external hemorrhoids). Make sure to avoid spicy, oily foods and take plenty of fibers to aid in digestion and ensure speedy recovery. Before taking OXERUTE CD TABLET inform your doctor if you have kidney problems.

Inform your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding before taking OXERUTE CD TABLET. Safety and effectiveness of OXERUTE CD TABLET in children has not been established yet, consult your doctor before taking it. The most common side effects of taking OXERUTE CD TABLET are flushing, headache, vertigo. Consult your doctor if symptoms do not reduce.
usesDetails:
Uses Of OXERUTE CD TABLET

It is used to manage:

Bleeding piles
Post piles surgery
mechanismOfAction:
How OXERUTE CD TABLET Works

OXERUTE CD TABLET is a combination of Calcium dobesilate and Troxerutin. Calcium dobesilate works on the walls of the small blood vessels and reduces their leakage and fragility. It also improves blood flow by decreasing viscosity, thickness of the blood, thereby relieving inflammation (redness and swelling) in hemorrhoids and promotes healing. Troxerutin strengthens the blood vessels in the affected area.
usageDetails:
How to use OXERUTE CD TABLET

Take OXERUTE CD TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the right dose and duration depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.
